purpose: Enforce proactive 60-minute publishing cooldown, eliminate the 5-minute scheduler retry storm on safe-gap errors, and intercept browser alert dialogs cleanly.
design_intent: Protect the forum account and server resources by preventing Chromium launches during the 60-minute cooldown window, while replacing the aggressive 5-minute error loop with intelligent backoff and cooldown alignment.

model_execution_guidance.note: Requires precise time arithmetic, Playwright event lifecycle handling, and scheduler timer reconfiguration. Fast models (Gemini Flash High) should execute changes in discrete batches (e.g., pre-flight gatekeeper first, scheduler loop second) with automated test verification after each batch.

work_items.title: Proactive 60-minute cooldown pre-flight gatekeeper
work_items.action: Before creating browser context in runPublisher(), query publisherHistory for the last successful publish. If elapsed time < 60 minutes, abort immediately without launching Chromium, calculate remaining minutes, set publishBlockedUntil, and return decision: 'rate_limited'.

work_items.title: Eliminate 5-minute scheduler spin loop
work_items.action: Remove hardcoded PUBLISHER_FAIL_RECHECK_INTERVAL = 5 for safe-gap errors. If run decision is rate_limited, schedule next tick for now + remainingMinutes + 1m buffer. If an unexpected error occurs, apply progressive exponential backoff (15m -> 30m -> 60m).

work_items.title: Intercept browser alert dialogs & expand rate-limit regex
work_items.action: Hook page.once('dialog') before clicking write button in runPublisherFlow.ts to capture Ppomppu alert text before auto-dismissal. Expand RATE_LIMIT_MARKER to match variant phrasing ('60분이 지나야', '1시간 이내에 1개').

work_items.title: Rationalize Slack rate-limit notifications
work_items.action: Demote rate_limited decisions from critical failure alerts (❌) to debug logging or a single quiet status notification.

gate_criteria: Unit tests for cooldown calculation pass
Scheduler schedules next tick after cooldown period, not 5 minutes
npm run lint passes with 0 errors
npm run test:unit passes all tests

handover_instructions.continuation_prompt: Phase 2 (Publisher & Scheduler Stabilization) is complete. Proceed to Phase 3 per .planning/spec-kit/specs/active/phase3-maintenance-engine-v1.json to implement platform maintenance window parsing ('점검 중 입니다') and the scheduler dynamic pause engine.
